members.name: value
members.doc: The value reported when this option is chosen.

members.name: label
members.doc: The text on the arc. Falls back to the value.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Shown dimmed; the dial never comes to rest on it.

types.name: ArcPickerProps
types.doc: A radial text picker. Options sit along an arc of a large dial and the chosen one rests at its apex, inside a pair of brackets that spring to the width of each new label. Turn the dial with the mouse wheel, by dragging along the arc, with the arrow keys, or by clicking a label.

members.name: options
members.doc: The options in order along the arc.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The value chosen at first (uncontrolled). Defaults to the first enabled option.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Runs when the dial settles on a new option.

members.name: side
members.doc: Which part of the dial shows: `top` arches up, `bottom` hangs down, `left` and `right` bow sideways with the labels stacked.

members.name: radius
members.doc: Radius of the dial in px. Larger is flatter. Defaults to 320 for the top and bottom arcs and 240 for the side arcs.

members.name: gap
members.doc: Distance between the centers of neighboring options along the arc, in px. By default each pair is spaced by its own label widths.

members.name: ticks
members.doc: Draws the tick marks that turn with the dial and the pointer at the apex.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the control off: it is dimmed and ignores pointer and keyboard input.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.

members.name: style
members.doc: Inline styles for the root element, for sizes and CSS variables.
